originalTitle: Spanish intelligence warned of Ceuta mass crossing plans before surge
title: A Big Story About Friends, Neighbors, and a Special City!
content:
Hello, my wonderful friends! It's me, your kid-friendly news reporter, bringing you exciting stories from our amazing continent, Africa, and our neighbors too! Today, we have a very special story about a place called Ceuta and how people help each other.

What is Ceuta?

Imagine a tiny, beautiful garden. This garden belongs to one family, but it's right next to a very big farm that belongs to another family. Ceuta is a little bit like that special garden! It's a city that belongs to a country called Spain. But guess what? It's not far away in Europe; it's right here, very, very close to Morocco, which is a country in Africa! So, Ceuta is like a special neighbor city between Africa and Europe. It’s a very interesting place because it has a wall, like a big fence, to show where Spain ends and Morocco begins. People go through special gates to visit or to work. It’s a busy place where many different people live and visit. Did you know? Ceuta is one of two Spanish cities that are on the continent of Africa! The other one is called Melilla.

People Wanting New Homes

Sometimes, grown-ups and their families might want to move to a new place. Maybe they are looking for a new job, or a safer place to live, or a school for their children. It’s like when your family moves to a new house to be closer to something important. These people are called migrants, which just means people who move from one place to another to find a new home or a better life. Many people from different countries in Africa sometimes try to go to Europe to find new chances. They hope for a better life there. It's a long journey for many of them.

A Special Message Was Shared!

Now, for our big story! Imagine if you and all your friends had special walkie-talkies. And one day, someone sent a message on the walkie-talkie saying, "Hey everyone, let's all meet at the park tomorrow to play!" Well, something a bit like that happened for the grown-ups. People were using their phones and computers to send messages to many, many other people. This is called 'social media.' On social media, people were talking about a plan. They were saying, "Let's all try to go into Ceuta together very soon!" These messages were like a big signal. A very big group of people, like a whole football stadium full of people, were planning to go to Ceuta all at once. That's what we call a 'mass crossing' – lots and lots of people crossing over together.

Grown-Ups Got the News

Guess what? The grown-ups who help keep everyone safe in Spain and Morocco found out about these messages! These special helpers are like the teachers and parents of the countries; we call them 'authorities.' They heard about the plan the day before it was going to happen. How did they find out? Well, there are special papers and reports that help them understand what's happening. Sometimes, these papers are secret for a while, but then they become 'declassified,' which means everyone can know what was in them. These declassified papers showed that the Spanish helpers and the Moroccan helpers were told about the messages. It's important for countries to know what's happening so they can be ready. They want to make sure everyone is safe and that things are organized.

A Very Big Day

So, because of all those messages, a lot of people started to arrive at the edges of Ceuta. It was a huge number of people, like more than ten thousand! Imagine if every single child in your whole town decided to go to one park at the very same time – that's how many people it was! It was a very busy and sometimes difficult day. The helpers from Spain and Morocco worked together. They had to be very careful to keep everyone safe because so many people were trying to cross at once. It's like when there's a very big crowd, and you need grown-ups to help make sure no one gets hurt. Did you know? Ten thousand is a super big number! If you had ten thousand pennies, you would have enough to buy many, many toys!

Countries Working Together

This story shows us something very important: even though countries are different, they often need to work together. Spain and Morocco are neighbors, and like good neighbors, they talk to each other and try to help each other, especially when something big happens. When many people arrived at Ceuta, the helpers from both countries tried their best to manage everything safely. They needed to make sure people were looked after and that everyone understood what was happening. It's like when you and your friend need to work together to build a tall tower with blocks. You both have to communicate and help each other to make it strong and safe. Countries do that too, but on a much bigger scale!

What Can We Learn?

From this story, we can learn that sometimes people want to find new places to live, and that's okay. We can also learn that it's super important for countries and their helpers to talk to each other and work as a team, especially during big moments. Being kind and understanding to everyone, no matter where they come from, is a wonderful thing. And knowing what's happening helps everyone be prepared and safe. It's all about cooperation and helping hands! Thank you for listening to our news today! See you next time for more amazing stories!

originalTitle: Google picks Finland for its largest single investment in Europe
title: Wow! Google Builds a Super Big Computer Home!
content:
Hello from Sunny Africa!

Hello, hello, my amazing friends! It's your friendly news reporter here, coming to you all the way from beautiful Africa! I have some super exciting news to share with you today, about a very, very big company you probably know. It's called Google!

What is Google, Anyway?

Do you ever ask your mummy or daddy to find pictures of cute animals on the internet? Or maybe you watch your favorite cartoons on YouTube? Do you use maps to see where places are? Well, Google helps with all of that and so much more! Google is like a magic helper that knows almost everything on the internet. It helps us find information, watch videos, send messages, and even play fun games online. It's a huge company that helps people all over the world, even right here in Africa! Did you know? The name "Google" comes from a very, very big number called a "googol"! It means a 1 with one hundred zeros after it. That's how many things Google wants to help you find!

A Giant Home for Computers!

Guess what? Google is going to build a super, super big building! This building is not for people to live in. It's going to be a giant home for lots and lots of super powerful computers. This special big building is called a "data centre." Imagine a library, but instead of books, it has millions and millions of computers! These computers store all the videos you watch, all the pictures you see, and all the games you play on the internet. Everything that is on the internet needs a home, and data centres are those homes!

Where is This Super Big House Going?

This super big computer house is going to be built far, far away from Africa. It's going to be in a country called Finland. Finland is in a part of the world called Europe. It's a place that can get very cold, with lots of snow and beautiful forests. Maybe you've heard of it, some people even say Santa Claus lives near there! Google chose Finland because it has good things for a data centre, like clean air and a good way to get electricity. Did you know? Because Finland is a cold country, the cool air outside can help keep the super hot computers inside the data centre from getting too hot! It's like giving the computers an air conditioner for free!

A Mountain of Money for Computers!

Building such a giant home for computers costs a lot of money. A really, really, really big amount of money! Google is going to spend about 13 billion Euros. That's a huge number! To help you imagine, 13 billion Euros is like having 13 thousand million tiny coins! It's enough money to buy so many toys, or build so many schools, or buy so many yummy snacks for every kid in a very, very big country! It shows just how important this new computer home is to Google.

Lots and Lots of New Jobs!

But this amazing news is not just about big computers and big money. It's also about people! Building this giant data centre will create tens of thousands of new jobs. What are jobs, you ask? Jobs are when mummies and daddies, aunties and uncles, and other grown-ups go to work. They use their skills to do important things. Some people might build the new building. Others might work inside, making sure all the computers are happy and working well. Some might bring food or clean the building. Tens of thousands of jobs means so many people will get work! Imagine a whole town, full of people, all getting new and exciting work to do. This is very good for the people in Finland, because having a job means they can earn money to take care of their families and buy things they need, like food and clothes and even books for their children. Did you know? Data centres need all sorts of different jobs! Not just computer experts, but also builders, cleaners, security guards, and people who look after the plants outside!

Why is This Good News for Everyone?

So, why is Google building such a huge computer house so far away? It's because the internet is getting bigger and bigger every day! More and more people, like you and me, are using the internet for learning, playing, and talking to friends. When we use the internet, all that information needs to go somewhere. This new data centre will help store all that information and make sure that Google can work super fast and smoothly for everyone. This means your videos will load quicker, your games won't freeze, and you can find information even faster.

How Does This Help Us in Africa?

Even though this big computer home is in Finland, it helps us all the way here in Africa too! The internet is like a giant web that connects the whole world. When Google builds a stronger, faster part of that web, it makes the whole web better for everyone. So, when you search for something on Google here in Africa, or watch a fun video, or learn something new, this big computer home in Finland helps make sure it all works perfectly for you. It means technology can help more people, learn more things, and connect with more friends, no matter where they are. Did you know? The internet travels through special cables under the ocean to connect different parts of the world, like Africa and Europe! These data centres are like the big brains at each end of the cables!

A Bright Future with Computers!

So, Google building this giant, super-duper computer home in Finland is very exciting news! It means faster internet, lots of new jobs, and a stronger connection for everyone around the world. It shows that even little actions on our phones or computers depend on big, amazing projects happening far away. It's all part of making our digital world a better, faster, and more fun place for all of us. And that's something to cheer about! Goodbye for now, my wonderful friends, from your news reporter in Africa!
summary: Google is building a very big new computer home, called a data centre, in Finland, which will cost a lot of money and create many new jobs.
whyMatters: This is important because it will make the internet work faster for everyone, store all our online information, and give thousands of people good jobs.
